_comment: Arrival entities kept out of this build. Files by name (models/, baked/), plugins by script path. Remove an entry once it is cleared.

files.benches-merged.glb: V3's seating presets draw the hall benches (admins can switch layouts)
files.library-chair.glb: V3's seating presets draw the library chairs
files.connect-table.glb: V3's own table export with the devices baked in; V3's table keeps them grabbable

plugins.plugins/fractal-tree-in-3d-1775809050978: remixed from another creator's Arrival vibe
plugins.plugins/insectswarm.mjs: remixed from another creator's Arrival vibe
plugins.plugins/splat-grass.mjs: remixed from another creator's Arrival vibe
plugins.plugins/stainedglasswindow.mjs: ported to three.js in src/stainedglass.ts (day and night glow)
plugins.plugins/welcome-desk-kiosk.mjs: V3's live Join panel stands on Evo's desk instead (the baked kiosk's buttons would not work)
plugins.plugins/garden-birds.mjs: a frozen capture of the flock; V3's animated birds fly instead
plugins.plugins/xrlibraryscreen.mjs: baked video player would not play, and it covers one of V3's live library panels; port its click-to-play first
